hooks.command: cd /home/user/Trading-app && git config user.email noreply@anthropic.com && git config user.name Claude && branch=$(git branch --show-current) && if [ -n "$branch" ]; then git fetch origin "$branch" --quiet 2>&1 | tail -3; behind=$(git log HEAD..origin/"$branch" --oneline 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$behind" != "0" ] && [ -n "$behind" ]; then echo "WARNING: local branch '$branch' is $behind commit(s) behind origin/$branch -- this checkout is stale. Run: git fetch origin $branch && git checkout -B $branch origin/$branch (after stashing/committing any local work first)."; fi; fi || true
cd /home/user/Trading-app && [ -f tsconfig.json ] && npm run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -8 || true
cd /home/user/Trading-app && [ -f .eslintrc.json ] && npm run lint 2>&1 | tail -20 || true
